name: Inaka de Kawaii Oyome-san to
original_name: 田舎で可愛いお嫁さんと
source:
Nishiyama Eita, the protagonist with an interest in agriculture,
is introduced to an elderly couple who run a farm through his parents’ connections.

The kind elderly couple offers him an unused house near their home to live in for free,
allowing him to work as a live-in farmhand.

Thus begins his daily life, working diligently in the fields from early morning until evening.

One day, after finishing work, he visits the elderly couple’s house—
and there, he meets their granddaughter, Hinano.
